summary: CCSC Technology International Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting and Special Meeting of Class A ordinary shareholders held September 1, 2026. Shareholders approved the re-election of directors, an increase in authorized share capital, a potential 20-for-1 share consolidation conditional on share price dropping below $1.00, and authorization for acquisitions up to $50 million. These are routine governance approvals. No event qualifies as a special situation such as a tender offer or going-private. Watch for future actions on share consolidation or acquisitions if conditions are met.
